title: First-mile vignette — hero tiles & modular onboarding capsule visuals
creator: Arielle Chen
description: Refresh the landing hero and supporting vignette tiles used across onboarding flows. This ticket covers production-ready hero art, a modular tile system ("capsule" components) for three onboarding pathways, and a screenshot/scaffold pipeline for marketing and docs. The goal is a compact hero that scales from small promo banners to full-width landing with consistent microcopy, motion cues, and exportable device screenshots. Focus areas: thumbnail legibility at 320px, accessible color contrast, and a screenshot export process that can be automated by Platform Engineering.
acceptance_criteria: Hero has three responsive variants (compact, medium, full) implemented in Figma and exported as layered PNG/SVG for dev
Modular capsule tiles (3 types) documented with layout rules, spacing tokens, and copy slots
Screenshot export pipeline documented with device presets (iPhone SE, iPhone 13, 13" laptop), naming convention, and automated PR checklist
Motion prototype for hero entrance and tile micro-interactions reviewed and signed off by Design and PM
Design tokens and color palette passes 4.5:1 contrast for body text and 3:1 for large headings per WCAG
Dev-ready assets uploaded to Drive and linked in ticket; PR for front-end integration created
comments: 2026-03-01 Arielle Chen: Kickoff — rough sketches for three tile types (overview, starter, advanced). Chose "capsule" metaphor to keep tiles compact on narrow viewports.
2026-03-03 Marco R. Diaz (PM): Reviewed sketches. Asked to prioritize thumbnail legibility and to keep one variant without screenshots for marketing banners.
2026-03-05 Arielle Chen: Uploaded first Figma draft with layout grid and token notes. Added microcopy options for CTA and supporting lines. Linked prototype for motion exploration.

2026-03-07 Design critique: Feedback from team (Liam, Priya, Noor) — prefer left-aligned microcopy on compact hero, suggested stronger separation between tile types, flagged color contrast for secondary text.
2026-03-09 Engineering sync: ENG-4129 assigned to implement screenshot export hook. Agreed on export filenames and device list. Noted front-end will accept both SVG and PNG slices.
2026-03-12 Arielle Chen: Updated tiles with accessible palette; created 'capsule-stack' hero variant (stacked tiles with subtle shadow). Export pipeline draft added to Confluence.

2026-03-15 QA Note: Small bug found in compact hero when rendered at 320px — avatar and token badges overlap. Assigned to DES-556002 to fix spacing rules.
decisions: Adopt 'capsule-stack' hero variant for initial rollout (stacks gracefully to single column on <=420px)
Color palette: Primary teal #0A8F85 for CTAs; neutral slate for body; token adjusted to meet 4.5:1 contrast
Grid: 8px baseline with 12-column constrained grid for full-width; capsule width set to 280/380/920 for compact/medium/full
Motion: entrance fade+up for hero (200ms), tile hover lift (60ms easing) — keep motion subtle to preserve perceived performance
Export format: layered SVG for decorative elements, 2x PNGs for device screenshots; naming prefix 'onboard_capsule_{variant}_{device}_{v1}'
